product_one_liner.value: Pack is an AI-powered people-development platform for organizations that maps employee skills, identifies gaps, and builds personalized development paths aligned with business goals.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL renders a coming-soon/contact landing page, not pricing plans, and the landing page has no pricing link.

named_customers.notes: Both companies have named case studies.

employee_band.notes: Based on the current profile's listed employee count of 251; older public headcount reports are lower.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index contains HR advice, leadership interviews and people-development content, rather than engineering posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: No documentation or help portal is linked from the landing page; the developers path displays the same landing-page content.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-positions board lists account-executive, BDR and full-stack-developer roles, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No named model or provider was found in the product/AI FAQ, blog or privacy policy reviewed, or through searches for public documentation and subprocessor disclosures.

raised_18mo.notes: The December 2025 Series A falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board includes a French-market account executive and multiple BDR openings.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying launch appears in the readable blog or company posts for May 9–November 9, 2026. The homepage advertises a future December 1 launch, which is not counted.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small published team lists the two longstanding co-founders as its C-level leaders; no qualifying join or departure was found for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.
